cases.description: Clear, low-risk recommendation cites current evidence.
An action candidate cannot cite an expired observation.
A pre-reconnect observation cannot support a current candidate.
Unknown evidence cannot support a candidate.
Conflicting evidence cannot support a candidate.
An abstention may disclose that relevant state is unknown.
An abstention may explain that its context has expired.
An abstention may explain that data belongs to an older session.
The v1 candidate profile rejects high-risk candidates.
Uncalibrated uncertainty cannot support a candidate.
Every candidate must cite supporting evidence.
A recommendation cannot be emitted without evidence.
Duplicate evidence identities are rejected.
Derived evidence must identify an existing prior parent.
A candidate citing a derived fact must cite its parent evidence too.
An expired proposal must not pass structural validation.
Future-dated evidence is rejected.
A candidate cannot rely on a source with no current session epoch.
A clarification cannot carry a candidate effect.
The initial semantic comfort target has a bounded range.
Unbounded proposal text is rejected.
Control characters in resident-facing summaries are rejected.
A candidate cannot state that no approval is required.
Unknown proposal schema versions are rejected.
A proposal generated in the future is rejected.
A clarification must identify what is unknown.
An explanation may disclose unknown evidence without using it for a candidate.
A candidate cannot duplicate an evidence citation.
Derived evidence must follow its parents in canonical order.
An explanation may disclose unavailable context.
